messages:
mara: FYI a customer onboarding sample app failed during route creation. REST call succeeds but JS SDK returns 422. Error says missing required field. Anyone hit param/shape drift between REST and SDK?
aj: Could be different field names or SDK dropping unknown top-level keys. Paste examples?
mara: Repro snippets: REST (works):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routes
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
  -d '{"name":"acct-test","model":"gpt-open-3","model_variant":"v2","timeout":30}'
```
JS SDK (422):
```js
// using @redwood/sdk v1.4.2 in sample app
client.routes.create({ name: 'acct-test', model: 'gpt-open-3', timeout_ms: 30000 })
// there is no model_variant in autocomplete and extra fields seem to be dropped
```
aj: Confirmed: SDK schema exposes timeout_ms (ms) and not timeout (seconds), and it strips unknowns. Backend expects model_variant and timeout (s). That explains validation failure.
sam: Also noticed the SDK wrapper has autoRetry enabled globally. For POST create-route that caused a duplicate resource after a transient 500 from infra. Customer reported two routes created.
mara: Server logs show duplicate POSTs a second apart with different request ids and no Idempotency-Key.
leo: Short-term mitigation: callers should set an Idempotency-Key header and disable autoRetry for non-idempotent calls. Example:
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ autoRetry: false, headers: { 'Idempotency-Key': uuid() } })
await client.routes.create(payload)
```
devex-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-4823: "js-sdk: align route create payload with REST (expose model_variant, accept timeout|timeout_ms), and change retry defaults for non-idempotent methods" https://tickets.redwood/DEVEX-4823 :robot_face:
aj: I'll take the SDK fix: - add model_variant to create shape (allow string), - accept timeout (s) or timeout_ms (ms) and normalize, - avoid dropping unknown top-level keys for create requests, - change retry middleware so autoRetry=true only for idempotent methods (POST opt-in via Idempotency-Key).
mara: I'll attach a minimal repro app + exact sdk version to the ticket and add a quick integration test that compares SDK-serialized payload to a canonical REST payload.
sam: Ops side: we should add a short-term alert for POSTs without Idempotency-Key that have near-duplicate payloads within a short window. I'll open a follow-up with eng-sre.
mara: Thanks everyone, will update DEVEX-4823 with repro and test results. Leaving the thread here. :thumbsup:
